capturedText: Meester Tweester n00b Offline fell 2044 times for marty Texas, USA Gender: Re: Mario Kart Tour TT Reply #40 - 10/26/19 at 19:45:27 Harambey180 wrote on 10/26/19 at 01:12:52: Meester Tweester wrote on 10/25/19 at 17:27:26: Yeah, I am the same Meester Tweester! It's been quite some time since the last episode, but I moved onto speedrunning. If you're wondering, since I am asked this frequently, the show isn't cancelled, and I don't have any inside info on its status. Here is YersonCz's 1:04.85 video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zyMlDQ5xeM0 Welcome to the Mario Kart speedrunning community! 'Quite some time', hmm? Like two years... I fear that the same thing will happen to TWOW like what happened to BAGUETTE. If for some reason not, I hope you win the thing! I was like five days too late bcuz I thought carykh didn't post many videos at the time. I guess I should start subscribing to channels I like... (I never do that) Thanks! I'm actually on the MK7 players page under "Clark", I read about the website in a magazine and I think most of my play was my own strategy. Sadly my old MK7 cartridge got corrupted. I grinded MKDS and MK7 time trials in 2011-2012, I was 12 then. That was I guess my first speedrunning years before I seriously competed in other games starting in 2018. Thanks for showing that 1:04.73 WR! I got 1:08.23 on TC and 1:08.23 on NBC today, Oct. 26, I can upload them if they're still my PBs. edit: oh yeah I was Clark because it was shortly before I made this username. I'm also the sole Malaysian player since I had moved there at the time.
